title: Identify and label speakers within a session
body:
Attach a stable speaker identity to each transcript segment so dialogue can be attributed to the right participant throughout a session.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Each TranscriptReceived event carries a consistent speaker identifier
- Speaker identity survives brief disconnects/reconnects within the same session

title: Persist full session metadata
body:
Store session-level metadata: start/end time, participants, and duration, independent of the transcript content itself.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- A Session record is created on SessionStarted and closed on session end
- Participants are linked to the sessions they attended

title: Build the campaign timeline from session events
body:
Derive a chronological timeline of the campaign from the sequence of sessions and their key events.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Timeline is queryable per campaign, ordered by session date
- Each timeline entry links back to its source session

title: Link transcripts to their originating session
body:
Ensure every persisted transcript entry references its session, so campaign history queries can retrieve dialogue in context.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Transcript entries always carry a session foreign key
- Deleting/archiving a session is a deliberate, explicit operation (no orphaned transcripts)
